name: populiweb.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 319 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.
lesson: Serve sitemap.xml from the same host as the pages it lists, and name it in robots.txt.
summary: populiweb.com scores 76 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 30 are at risk, and 30 pass. Fix first: 41 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 41 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /features/, /for-everyone/, /customers/ and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 319 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: populi.co (319). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://populiweb.com.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (3 requests), Google Ads (2 requests), LinkedIn Insight (1 request), and cookies _ga, _gcl_au, _ga_4W7TBRPGHS, bcookie on linkedin.com, li_gc on…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 19 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 18 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /features/, /customers/, /pricing/, /get-a-demo/ and 14 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /features/, /for-everyone/, /customers/ and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 167 ms
